query: SELECT g.tenant_id, g.credential_id, g.namespace_id FROM tenants AS t JOIN credential_grants AS g ON g.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.state = 'deleted' AND t.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM namespaces AS n WHERE n.tenant_id = t.id AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF g SKIP LOCKED
